capabilities: connect an Anotum account via anotum.com
sync highlights into the vault as Markdown notes
customize the note template with variables and filters
trigger a manual sync on demand
extras: The README states an Anotum trial or subscription is required, the plugin only communicates with the service to pull highlights, and no telemetry is collected; default template variables and filters are documented.
intentEvidence: This official plugin provides a seamless bridge between your Anotum library and your Obsidian vault
problem: Highlights saved in the Anotum reading platform are not available as searchable Markdown notes inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: turning your highlights into active, searchable Markdown notes

summary: Official sync plugin that pulls Anotum reading highlights and notes into an Obsidian vault as Markdown notes using a customizable template.
